visual_style: Vertical 9:16, crisp warm daylight, energetic realistic cinematic look with named camera moves. Pakistani settings: government schools with whitewashed walls, plain green blackboards with no writing, wooden desks, pupils in school uniform. Modest dress. No on-screen text, letters, captions, logos or watermarks anywhere in the frame; papers and screens are blurred and unreadable. Recipe v2: in shots 1 and 5 the on-screen presenter speaks to the camera; in shots 2-4 an unseen narrator speaks as a voice-over and nobody on screen speaks.

narrator.name: presenter and voice-over
narrator.description: On screen in shots 1 and 5: a confident Pakistani woman teacher in her thirties in a mustard shalwar kameez and a white dupatta, speaking Urdu to the camera with a lively, quick, enthusiastic delivery. Shots 2-4: an unseen Pakistani woman narrator, lively and quick, voice-over only.

shots.visual: At a classroom door, a confident Pakistani woman teacher in her thirties in a mustard shalwar kameez and a white dupatta welcomes pupils as they come in happily, including a girl using a wheelchair, then turns to the camera; quick push-in to a close-up.
Fast handheld orbit around a group table where a boy wearing a hearing aid and his classmates build a cardboard model together, laughing.
Tracking shot as a teacher kneels with a small group using large picture cards, and a pupil with a white cane traces a raised tactile chart with her fingers.
Rising crane shot over a school courtyard where teachers and parents sit together at a parent-teacher meeting, nodding and smiling.

In a sunlit school corridor, a confident Pakistani woman teacher in her thirties in a mustard shalwar kameez and a white dupatta walks briskly toward the camera, holds up a phone with a blurred screen and smiles; fast push-in to a close-up as pupils walk past softly in the background.

narration: ہر بچہ مختلف ہے۔ کیا آپ کی کلاس میں ہر بچے کے لیے جگہ ہے؟
اس کورس میں آپ segregation سے inclusion تک کا سفر اور learners کی diversity سمجھیں گے۔
inclusive teaching strategies، classroom management اور Pakistan کے قوانین، تاکہ ہر بچہ پوری طرح شریک ہو۔
چھ units، والدین اور ساتھی اساتذہ کے ساتھ مل کر کام کرنے کی مہارت تک۔
پورا کورس مفت پڑھیں textbook ڈاٹ کام ڈاٹ پی کے پر۔ لنک نیچے ہے۔
